errors.text: The proposed Al2O3 coating is unsupported by prior evidence and does not reconstruct the hydride-assisted printing, hydrogen de-binding, gettered vacuum sintering, quenching, and silicide-coating strategy.
The hypothesis incorrectly treats the reported 8–16% room-temperature tensile ductility as a property to be maintained at 1000 °C.
It assumes that an Al2O3 layer will remain adherent and diffusion-tight without addressing thermal-expansion mismatch, cracking, spallation, or interfacial reactions.
The falsification rule is too weak: failure to reduce oxidation relative to the untreated alloy should itself falsify the hypothesis, rather than requiring an increased oxidation rate.
